class.name: FPSCounter
class.description: A [Label] that shows the current frames per second, optionally with the frame time and memory usage. The text is colored green, yellow or red depending on performance.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the text is green at 55 FPS or more, yellow between 30 and 55 FPS and red below 30 FPS.
If [code]true[/code], also shows the frame time in milliseconds.
If [code]true[/code], also shows the static memory usage.
How often the text is updated, in seconds.
